note: What the kit has checked in UEFN for each mechanic of mechanics-catalog.json. how: recipe, device, verse or no. verified: true only when it was run or compiled in the editor.

ai.enemy_spawn_director.note: waves in order, one spawner per wave; compiles on 43.00

economy.loot_table.note: a button opens a box, one item picked by weight

economy.shop.note: earn money over time, buy a reward with a button

survival.hunger.note: a need falls, a button restores it, an empty need hurts

puzzle.sequence_memory.note: the ordered triggers are the base; the memory game needs more Verse

ui_ux.checkpoint_notification.note: the checkpoint recipe respawns; the message is a HUD message device

camera.screen_shake.what: UEFN has no direct camera shake
camera.screen_shake.note: use sound, effects and text for the feel (game-feel-uefn)

progression.achievement_system.note: see the uefn-quests skill; compiled in the lab, not run

ui_ux.quest_marker.what: objective_device or tracker_device with the Progression API

accessibility.adjustable_difficulty.note: a difficulty setting read in Verse that scales spawner counts and damage

accessibility.assist_mode.note: a Verse preset that switches several assists on together

accessibility.colorblind_modes.note: a Fortnite player setting, not controllable from a map; use shape and text cues

accessibility.text_scaling.note: a Fortnite player setting; keep map text large by design

accessibility.toggle_hold_option.note: a Fortnite player setting for standard inputs

ai.chase.note: guards chase on perception; wildlife spawners also pursue

ai.investigate_noise.note: guards react to noise and last known position

ai.line_of_sight_detection.note: fires when a player is seen; also Trigger_Perception

ai.patrol.note: a path for guards to walk; used with GuardSpawner_V2

camera.camera_lock_on.note: no lock-on camera device; fake with Verse or a fixed perspective

camera.smooth_follow_camera.note: changes the player camera mode; smooth follow is not a setting

camera.top_down_camera.note: top-down style via the camera/perspective devices; check the options

combat.aim_down_sights.note: a weapon behaviour of the item, not a map device

combat.block.note: no block action for players; Verse could fake it with damage handling

combat.combo_chain.note: count hits in a time window in Verse; MeleeDesigner for the swings

combat.damage_over_time.note: damage every interval while inside; FireVolume_V2 for burning

combat.guard_break.note: no direct way; Verse over damage events

combat.hit_stun.note: no direct way; Verse could briefly disable movement

combat.invincibility_frames.note: a short protection window in Verse; island settings have a spawn immunity time

combat.knockback.note: Verse launch/push on damage; needs a check of the exact call

combat.melee_attack.note: designs melee weapons: damage, speed, range

combat.shield.note: grants shield items; PowerUp for a timed effect (check)

crafting.crafting_queue.note: a timed queue in Verse with ItemGranter at the end

crafting.recipe_crafting.note: a conditional button checks items, ItemRemover and ItemGranter finish the recipe

crafting.workbench.note: a bench for weapon mods; for general crafting use a button plus Verse

economy.resource_conversion.note: ItemRemover takes the input, ItemGranter gives the output, a button triggers it

horror.hiding.note: makes a player look like a prop; a hide spot also needs a Verse or trigger rule

horror.light_resource.note: a light-energy value in Verse with PointLight devices

horror.safe_room.note: a barrier with a trigger; a Timer can close it

horror.sanity_meter.note: a stat kept in Verse and shown with HUDController_V2

meta.player_profile_stats.note: persistent data in Verse; GlobalSaveData for shared data

movement.air_dash.note: no direct device; a launch in Verse

movement.dash.note: a launch in Verse; MovementModulator for speed boosts

movement.slide.note: a default player action; class settings may toggle it

movement.sprint.note: speed changes; ClassDesigner for the sprint option

movement.stamina_movement.note: a stamina value in Verse that drives MovementModulator

multiplayer.matchmaking_lobby.note: lobby through round and spawn settings; MatchmakingPortal_V2 sends players to another island

narrative.branching_dialogue.note: a conversation device; PopupDialog and ModalDialog for choices

narrative.codex_journal.note: a UI list kept in Verse

narrative.reputation_choice.note: a score per faction in Verse

narrative.reputation_gating.note: Verse check that opens a LockDevice or Barrier

physics.physics_push_pull.note: prop manipulation; PhysicsBoulder_V2 for pushable bodies (check)

platforming.double_jump.note: class option for jumping (check); otherwise Verse

platforming.variable_jump_height.note: MovementModulator changes jump height, not variable by press

procedural_generation.biome_generation.note: no runtime way; PCG graphs make scenery while building (editor tools)

procedural_generation.loot_generation.note: random item spawner; RNG device for weighted picks

procedural_generation.room_connection_gr.note: a graph and spawn/teleport logic in Verse

procedural_generation.seeded_generation.note: Verse random with your own seed value

progression.equipment_rarity.note: item rarity is a setting of the granted item

progression.skill_tree.note: a tree of unlock flags in Verse with a UI

progression.unlockable_abilities.note: Verse with ClassDesigner/ClassSelector for class abilities

progression.upgrade_shop.note: vending machine with costs; ItemSpawnerVendingMachine variant

puzzle.sliding_block.note: moves a prop on a path from a trigger

rhythm.beat_matching.note: timing check in Verse; DrumSequencer for the audio

rhythm.note_lane.note: lanes and notes drawn with UI in Verse

roguelike.permadeath.note: spawn limit / elimination ends the run; EliminationManager

roguelike.pick_one_upgrade_choice.note: choice UI in Verse; Simple_Voting_Option for a simple vote

roguelike.procedural_floor.note: Verse picks and activates room groups

roguelike.random_powerups.note: power-up device with RNG to choose

roguelike.relic_synergy.note: rules over owned relic flags in Verse

simulation.needs_simulation.note: values over time in Verse with a HUD

stealth.noise_meter.note: derive from player movement in Verse

stealth.shadow_cover.note: light volumes plus a Verse check

stealth.visibility_meter.note: Verse computes it from distance and light

survival.durability.note: an item property, not a map setting

survival.health.note: max health per class; HealPowerup and DamageVolume_V2 change it

survival.oxygen.note: no direct way; a Verse timer while in Water_V2

traversal.grappling_hook.note: no grapple device; Zipline, GrindVine and GrindRail are the near options

ui_ux.cooldown_indicator.note: HUDMessage for text; a bar needs Verse UI

ui_ux.interaction_prompt.note: interact text on the button device

ui_ux.inventory_grid.note: a custom Verse UI; the Fortnite inventory is fixed

vehicles.fuel.note: a fuel pump device (check how fuel is modeled)

vehicles.vehicle_acceleration.note: vehicle stats are fixed per vehicle; VehicleModBoxSpawner gives mods

vehicles.vehicle_braking.note: vehicle stats are fixed per vehicle
